site.tagline: Cinematic stories, crafted frame by frame.
site.description: Buddies Production is a premium film & video production studio in Guwahati, Assam — crafting cinematic commercials, music videos, documentaries and wedding films.

hero.subtitle: Film & Video Production Studio
hero.paragraph: A premium production studio in Guwahati crafting commercials, music videos, documentaries and wedding films with obsessive cinematic detail.

about.titleMain: A crew of storytellers obsessed with the
about.description: Buddies Production is a full-service film studio based in Guwahati, Assam. From the first spark of an idea to the final graded frame, we handle direction, cinematography, editing and sound in-house — so every project keeps its soul from script to screen.
about.cardDesc: Directors, DOPs, editors and colourists — one team, one vision.

services.title: Commercials & Ads
services.body: High-impact brand films and TV commercials engineered to sell, shot with cinema-grade craft.

services.title: Music Videos
services.body: Bold, rhythm-driven visuals with striking art direction that make artists unforgettable.

services.title: Documentaries
services.body: Honest, emotional storytelling — from concept and interviews to the final graded cut.

services.title: Wedding Films
services.body: Timeless cinematic wedding films that turn a single day into a story worth reliving.

services.title: Post Production
services.body: Editing, sound design, VFX and colour grading that give every frame its final polish.

services.title: Aerial & Drone
services.body: Sweeping cinematic aerials and dynamic movement that add scale and drama to any scene.

rentals.title: Cinema Cameras
rentals.description: RED, ARRI & Sony cinema bodies with pro media, ready for any format from commercials to features.

rentals.title: Prime & Zoom Lenses
rentals.description: Full sets of cinema primes and zooms — sharp, characterful glass for every focal length you need.

rentals.title: Lighting Kits
rentals.description: Aputure, Nanlux & HMI lighting with modifiers, stands and grip to shape dramatic, cinematic looks.

rentals.title: Drones & Aerial
rentals.description: Licensed drone rigs for sweeping cinematic aerials, with certified pilots available on request.

rentals.title: Audio & Sound
rentals.description: Boom kits, lav sets, field recorders and monitoring for clean, broadcast-ready production sound.

rentals.title: Gimbals & Movement
rentals.description: Sliders, dollies, gimbals and stabilised rigs to add smooth, dynamic motion to every shot.

dubbing.description: Guwahati's premier soundproof acoustic facility for cinema dubbing, song recording, dialogue ADR, podcasts, and commercial voiceovers — fully equipped with industry-standard gear.
dubbing.cardDesc: Instant slot reservation & sound engineer assistance
dubbing.whatsappMessage: Hi Buddies Production, I want to book a slot for the Dubbing & Recording Studio. Please share available timings and rates.

features.title: Cinema Dubbing Booth
features.desc: Acoustically isolated vocal suite with multi-layer soundproofing for clean, resonant voice takes.

features.title: Vocal & Music Recording
features.desc: High-end studio condenser mics (Neumann, Shure, AKG) for singers, voiceover artists & podcasts.

features.title: Foley, SFX & Audio Post
features.desc: Dedicated Foley space, custom sound design, ADR, audio restoration and stereo/5.1 cinematic mix.

features.title: Live Video Sync Monitoring
features.desc: Zero-latency picture-to-sound sync playback monitors for flawless dubbing and character timing.

costumes.description: Bring your characters to life with our extensive rental inventory of cinema-grade period costumes, cultural attires, dramatic theater outfits, and custom styling props in Guwahati.
costumes.bannerDesc: Hundreds of ready character outfits, historical garments, crowns, accessories & on-set dresser support.
costumes.whatsappMessage: Hi Buddies Production, I want to rent character costumes for my shoot. Please share available catalog and sizes.

categories.title: Historical & Period Royalty
categories.desc: Elaborate royal attire, embroidered robes, crowns, jewelry and velvet garments for period cinema & epics.

categories.title: Traditional & Cultural Outfits
categories.desc: Authentic Assamese folk & cultural wardrobe, Bihu costumes, traditional silk drapes, turbans and ornaments.

categories.title: Theatrical, Action & Mythological
categories.desc: Character armor, warrior vests, stage drama outfits, custom mythical character sets and prop weaponry.

categories.title: Modern & Music Video Stylized
categories.desc: High-fashion couture, edgy streetwear, leather jackets and designer ensembles tailored for screen visuals.
